description: This file implements a disk-based Least Recently Used (LRU) cache, originally taken from Android's internal libraries. It manages cache entries stored as files, handles concurrent access, and maintains cache size constraints via a journal and background cleanup tasks.

classes.name: DiskLruCache
classes.description: Main class managing the disk-based cache with methods for opening, editing, retrieving, and deleting cache entries, as well as managing the journal for cache consistency.

classes.name: DiskLruCache.Snapshot
classes.description: Represents an immutable snapshot of a cache entry's data streams and provides methods to access data.

classes.name: DiskLruCache.Editor
classes.description: Allows editing of cache entries, providing input and output streams for data modification, and methods to commit or abort the edits.

classes.name: DiskLruCache.Entry
classes.description: Represents individual cache entries, tracking file lengths, metadata, readability, and the current editor.

methods.name: DiskLruCache.open
methods.description: Static method to open or create a cache in a specified directory with configuration parameters.

methods.name: DiskLruCache.get
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of a cache entry by key, if it exists and is readable.

methods.name: DiskLruCache.edit
methods.description: Returns an editor for a cache entry to modify its values.

methods.name: DiskLruCache.remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry if it exists and is not being edited.

methods.name: DiskLruCache.close
methods.description: Closes the cache, releasing resources but leaving stored data intact.

methods.name: DiskLruCache.delete
methods.description: Deletes all cache data and files.
